sections.content: Use *porque*, debido a, ya que, por eso, por lo *tanto* and como consecuencia to explain what caused a problem and what happened afterwards.

items.spanish: El problema se agravó porque no se actuó a tiempo.
items.english: The problem got worse because action was not taken in time.

items.spanish: La avería tuvo su origen en un fallo técnico.
items.english: The breakdown originated in a technical failure.

items.spanish: La falta de mantenimiento desencadenó nuevos problemas.
items.english: The lack of maintenance triggered new problems.

items.spanish: Por lo tanto, fue necesario buscar otra solución.
items.english: Therefore, it was necessary to look for another solution.

sections.content: Keep the cause and consequence logically connected, and distinguish the original cause from later effects.
